personal_details.name: Md. Zahid Hasan
personal_details.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
personal_details.bio: I build thoughtful web products and internal tools with a focus on clear interfaces, dependable integrations, and maintainable implementation.
about_paragraphs: I work across customer-facing products, admin panels, and internal tools that need to be clear, dependable, and useful in day-to-day work.
My role usually covers both product thinking and implementation, from interface decisions and API integration to the practical details required to ship responsibly.
Whether I am contributing to a team or handling a focused engagement independently, I aim for straightforward communication, sensible tradeoffs, and code that stays maintainable as the product grows.

experiences.summary: Building the frontend for a restaurant operations and ordering platform, covering order flow, admin tooling, and everyday usability.
highlights: Built SvelteKit dashboards for order intake, kitchen routing, and operational visibility.
Improved menu, inventory, and fulfillment workflows for internal teams.
Improved responsiveness and load times across the product.

experiences.summary: Built seller, admin, and customer service interfaces, including live communication and workflow-heavy internal features.
highlights: Implemented WebSocket-based chat and notifications alongside secure gateway integrations.
Improved image upload handling and Excel-based workflows used by internal teams.
Worked with design, QA, and backend teams to ship production releases.

experiences.summary: Maintained core seller, admin, and support products with a focus on frontend structure, speed, and everyday usability.
highlights: Improved performance with SSR, code splitting, and lazy loading across core interfaces.
Built chat features with WebSockets and integrated secure service gateways.
Handled API integrations and bulk data workflows used in daily operations.

experiences.summary: Contributed frontend features and API integrations for production web platforms across different business domains.
highlights: Improved responsiveness and cross-browser behavior for the Swisscontact BD site.
Built frontend components and REST API integrations for the Payra Port Water Management project.
